decision_reason: The bounded live preflight inspected five exact planned objects without downloading a complete object. The two FLARE demo objects matched identity and declare one video and one audio track with plausible timelines, but their 745.96421875-second and 766.862-second durations fail the inclusive 1,200–5,400-second gate. All three Omni requests ended in HTTP 403 before identity or stream inspection, so they remain access-blocked/unverified rather than audio-negative. Rights and acquisition gates remain closed for all five.
next_authorized_action: Do not acquire any of the five. Preserve ccp-005 and ccp-006 only as exact engineering/container compatibility fixtures. Expand the search for immutable candidates that already satisfy the 1,200–5,400-second long-video gate; do not relax the 20-minute lower bound. Resolve Omni gate/access only if its expected scientific value justifies a new item-scoped authorization request, then rerun bounded inspection rather than full acquisition.
